run_denoising_loop_forward: run the denoising loop by calling forward on a batch with server arguments

enable_cache_dit_transformer: enable cache-dit optimization on a transformer for delayed step computation

verify_denoising_inputs: verify denoising stage input tensors and parameters against expected types and constraints
